verdict.rationale: Codegen's CLI can pull branches and code changes created by agents into your local environment, so you can inspect an agent's changes directly. Nothing documented shows a diff-review and approve gate that must be passed before a PR is opened. Structured plans and the PR-creation permission toggle are adjacent controls and earn no credit here. missing for 10: an in-product diff review view, an explicit approve-before-PR gate, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request

citations.quote: Pull agent work - Download branches and code changes created by agents directly to your local environment
Use it to view agents, pull their work, create new agents
